name: W3C Web Payment Security Interest Group
status: Chartered 2025-04-01 to 2027-03-31 (shortname securepay); the draft Agentic Web charter lists the IG for "agentic payments". At TPAC the IG met on 2026-10-26, with agenda items on agentic payment updates from a FIDO technical working group and on the EMVCo Agentic Payments Framework, and on 2026-10-27, jointly with other groups; no resolutions are recorded in the draft minutes (read 2026-11-09). On 2026-11-02 WebKit published an explainer and "a very early and unofficial draft" of a payment method, digital-credential-payment, that uses the Digital Credentials API inside Payment Request (WebKit/explainers PR #160, merged the same day), after announcing it at the Web Payments WG meeting of 2026-10-29; it is not a W3C document.
relevance: Mission: "enhance the security and interoperability of various Web payments technologies"; a W3C staff member expected the e-commerce workshop to identify future workstreams for this group (webai-roadmap#45, 2026-06-11).

evidence.read: On 2026-11-09: the draft minutes of the IG of 2026-10-26 and 2026-10-27 and of the Web Payments WG of 2026-10-29, and WebKit/explainers PR #160.
evidence.not_read: Member-only mailing list, wiki sub-pages, TPAC 2025 minutes of the IG; w3c/wpsig is empty in the files read.
